dct_description_sm:
MPlus files and output for the multi-level modelling analysis are available in a linked dataset in Dataverse. 

Lau, Nathan T.T.; Ansari, Daniel; Thampi, Nisha; Srivastava, Prachi, 2022, "Mplus Files for Analysis of Student COVID-19 School Infections (Ontario 2020-21)", https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/IJOWDY, Scholars Portal Dataverse,

This dataset includes the R-script, final dataset, and the accompanying codebook that was used to conduct analysis of elementary school student infections in Ontario, Canada for the 2020-21 school year. Analysis appears in the pre-print by Srivastava et al. (2022), 'Effects of socio-economic factors on elementary school student COVID-19 infections in Ontario, Canada', medRxiv. https://doi.org/10.1101/2022.02.04.22270413
dct_title_s: Final Dataset for Analysis of Student COVID-19 Infections in Schools (Ontario 2020-21)
